params.name: value
params.description: The value you want to convert.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional historical date to convert with (format: 2021-12-31). Defaults to the latest rates.

params.name: base_currency
params.description: The base currency to which all results are behaving relative to. Defaults to USD.

params.name: currencies
params.description: A list of comma-separated currency codes you want to receive (e.g. EUR,USD,CAD). Defaults to all available currencies.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of currency you want to get. Defaults to all types.

items.docs: Converts a monetary value from the base currency into one or more target currencies, using today's rates or the rates of a given historical date.
